preconditions.description: The input is a single integer n (1 ≤ n ≤ 100000) representing the number of volumes and free places.

postconditions.expression: len(stdout.strip().split()) == n and all(1 <= int(x) <= n for x in stdout.strip().split())
postconditions.description: The output is a sequence of n integers, each between 1 and n inclusive, representing a permutation of the volumes.

postconditions.expression: all(1 <= j <= n for j in range(1, n + 1)) and all(1 <= p_j <= n for p_j in map(int, stdout.strip().split())) and len(set(map(int, stdout.strip().split()))) == n
postconditions.description: The output is a valid permutation p of the volumes 1..n, where p(j) is the volume at position j.

postconditions.expression: all(i >= 1 and all(not (j % i == 0 and p_j % i == 0) for j in range(1, n + 1) if j % i == 0) for i in range(1, n + 1)) or (i >= 1 and any(j % i == 0 and p_j % i == 0 for j in range(1, n + 1)) for i in range(1, n + 1))
postconditions.description: The permutation p minimizes the number of divisors i (1 ≤ i ≤ n) such that there exists at least one position j (1 ≤ j ≤ n) where both j and p(j) are divisible by i. If multiple permutations achieve this minimum, any valid permutation is acceptable.
